expect_red: a joint between two parts of one row with a part between them leaves by the row's flank and runs under that part, so no route is drawn through a box it does not end on

mutations.contract: A feature whose every interface is with a part in its own row beyond a part between them takes the row's outer flank.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_pitch_plate_is_an_assembly_with_its_bushings (2026-11-18). Without the row's flank, the pitch plate assembly's tangential-link flanged bushing -- pinned to the plate's attachment bore with the machined plate between them in model v2's row -- leaves its side straight into the machined plate. Re-pointed 2026-11-19 (a_map_pin_faces_each_partner_and_no_two_routes_share_a_run), when a feature's pin side became one per interface. Re-pointed 2026-11-22 (the_lug_stacks_line_up_and_each_link_is_a_row_on_the_map), when the detour's flank became the one with fewer parts beside the span.
mutations.replace: if (way) return way === "row" ? sideTowards(placeOf[part], placeOf[far]) : detourFlank(placeOf[part], placeOf[far], way);
